The '''Kol Huro system''' was a [[Factory world/Legends|factory system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. [[Mustag Olus]], a local tyrant [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] influenced by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], devoted all seven planets in the system to developing and manufacturing [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and weapons, such as the [[Kol Huro combat droid]]. The tyrant then [[Kol Huro Unrest|rose up]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] but was defeated by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]].

The system was conquered by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion of the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
